cs16_benchmark.source: Re-based 2026-11-11 (architect, after band boot 3) on the three fold-on control boots EXP2339/EXP2341/EXP2348 with the cmd wait form (harness 1ad9f966b): mean of the per-boot worst of warm r2/r3 (52.199 / 52.075 / 53.048); lowest control boot -0.70 %.
